quote: Equinox Gold Corp. completed the previously announced sale of its Aurizona Mine, RDM Mine and Bahia Complex located in Brazil (the “Brazil Operations”) to a subsidiary of the CMOC Group for total consideration of up to $1.015 billion (the “Transaction”). Equinox Gold received cash proceeds of $900 million, before closing adjustments, and will receive a production linked contingent cash payment of up to $115 million on January 23, 2027.
note: Opened Equinox Gold company news 23 Jan 2026 naming CMOC Group buyer.
